notes: Eclipse Loop 2.1.1 A trial-enforcement fix. If you have bought Eclipse Loop, nothing here changes anything for you — every one of these paths already worked and still works. Update anyway: it is the same build everyone else will be on. What was wrong The 14-day trial locks Save, Export, Bounce, drag-out, stem separation and slice export. Seven of those paths checked your licence. Five did not, and the app would happily hand a finished loop or a full set of song stems to an expired trial: - The DRAG WAV chip. Drag your loop out as a WAV, no licence needed. The DRAG MIDI chip immediately beside it was checked — which is exactly why nobody noticed. The pair looked symmetrical. - File ▸ Export All, File ▸ Export Song Stems, and File ▸ Export Selection as WAV ran straight through. The menu's other export items were checked, so the menu looked done.
